snippet.title: Cities: Skylines - Now available on Stadia
snippet.description:
Cities: Skylines is now available on Stadia! Create, grow and manage your city: from planning road networks to addressing the citizens’ needs, Cities: skylines allows you to unleash your creativity, and engage with a deep and robust city-simulation gameplay.

From holiday resorts to big industrial urban conglomerates - all the possibilities are now just a click away, thanks to Cities: Skylines - Stadia Edition!
